_note: FICTIONAL TEST DATA. Process-only. Staff names are invented; no player data.

answers.inventory_missing: Imaging files are received from the external provider; the admin team knows the transfer process.
answers.cover_gap: Not defined. Usually the head coach is told verbally.
answers.handover: WhatsApp message to the deputy, no written template.

choices: Youth players training with first team

answers.roster_definition: First-team list from the team manager, updated after each registration window and when youth players are called up for the week.
answers.attendance_definition: Present at the start of the session in kit, even if only partial participation.

unique_vs_events.detail: Daily report shows unique players; monthly report counts player-sessions. Fictional example: 25 unique players, 44 player-sessions on a double day.

ampm_counting.detail: GPS report counts per session; availability report counts per day.

answers.repeat_entries: Last entry before cut-off wins; earlier entry is overwritten without a record.
answers.availability_definition: Team Doctor decides by 09:00. Modified = trains with the group with restrictions agreed with the physio.
answers.vas_definition: VAS 0-10 scale, asked by the physio before treatment. Definition is not written down anywhere.

rpe_scale.detail: Collected 30 minutes after the session in the app. sRPE = RPE x session minutes.

answers.load_definitions: Speed bands set by the vendor default; not documented by the club.
answers.source_of_truth: Not agreed. GPS is used for load, attendance sheet for availability.

approval_required.detail: Weekly summary approved by the Head of Medical.

answers.qc_error_flow: Message to the report owner on WhatsApp.
answers.correction_process: Corrected file re-sent with 'UPDATED' in the subject. Changes are not listed.
answers.archive_rules: No formal archive or retention period.
answers.approved_storage: Not formally approved. Medical shared drive is the de facto store.

whatsapp_use.detail: Daily availability status shared in the staff group.

answers.channels_to_stop: Local laptop storage and WhatsApp groups for status updates.

doctor_input_status.detail: Replaced by the Doctor Input web app in July 2026 (fictional example); old workbook kept on laptop.

answers.sd_shareable: Availability status, expected return window and team-level counts.
answers.access_exceptions: Head of Medical approves by email; not logged centrally.
answers.repeated_tasks: Re-typing availability from the app into the weekly PDF; reformatting GPS exports.
answers.double_entry: Availability entered in the app and again in the weekly Excel.
answers.pain_points: 1) Double entry. 2) No single archive. 3) Unclear definitions for AM/PM counting.
answers.automation_candidates: Weekly summary and monthly attendance counts.
answers.future_fields: Availability category, training participation, expected return window, comment field (restricted).
answers.future_outputs: Daily availability PDF for the coach by 09:30; weekly summary for the sporting director.
answers.future_alerts: Reminder at 08:45 if entries are missing.
answers.future_integrations: GPS export and the wellness app.
answers.future_must_not: Must not share clinical notes outside medical staff.
answers.signoff_reviewers: Head of Performance; Head of Football Intelligence
